purpose: Present host-supplied validation errors as a named, focusable summary with links to invalid fields.
behaviorProvider: Native React composition with existing shared Aegis controls; see explicit component and host responsibilities.

component: native field link and focus behavior
host: revealing hidden fields and custom control focus

requirements.statement: Supply errors from application validation. The summary does not infer validity, mark controls invalid or decide when to validate.
Reject duplicate or empty error IDs and empty field IDs. Render no summary when the supplied list is empty.
Render each message through the shared Link with an encoded fragment targeting the supplied field ID. React escapes message text.

For ordinary unmodified activation, focus the element found by its exact ID and scroll it into view; alternatively call the supplied focusField callback. Modified activations retain native link behavior.
Provide a visible focusable field target. For hidden tabs, composite controls or asynchronously revealed fields, use focusField to reveal and focus the correct control.
A changed, defined focusRequestKey focuses the summary when errors exist. Ordinary rerenders with the same key do not steal focus.
Change focusRequestKey after failed submission when appropriate. The component intentionally does not force an alert role or automatically focus on each validation edit.
Keep owned summary structure in feedback tokens; nested Link retains trigger tokens and focus styling.

limitations: No validation engine, field mutation, router handling or automatic error dismissal.
A field that is missing, disabled, hidden or not focusable needs host handling.
Programmatic focus is an explicit caller request, not evidence that all assistive technologies announce identical text.
